name: 2 Timothy
kanji: テモテへの第二の手紙
lede: The fifty-fifth book of the Bible, in full: Paul's last letter, from his bonds at Rome, to Timothy his beloved child — the unfeigned faith of Lois and Eunice; stir up the gift of God; I know him whom I have believed; a good soldier of Christ Jesus; the word of God is not bound; a workman that needeth not to be ashamed; the firm foundation of God standeth; in the last days grievous times shall come; every scripture inspired of God; preach the word; I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith; only Luke is with me; bring the cloak and the books, especially the parchments, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: I Have Kept the Faith
books.blurb: Paul, an apostle, to Timothy, my beloved child; the unfeigned faith that dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois and thy mother Eunice; stir up the gift of God; God gave us not a spirit of fearfulness; I know him whom I have believed; the house of Onesiphorus; suffer hardship with me, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus; remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead; the word of God is not bound; a workman handling aright the word of truth; the firm foundation of God standeth; vessels unto honor; in the last days grievous times shall come; as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses; from a babe thou hast known the sacred writings; every scripture inspired of God; preach the word; I am already being offered; I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith; the crown of righteousness; only Luke is with me; the cloak, the books, the parchments; the Lord stood by me; come before winter.
